svg.title: KELNA 0.14 — both copper routing layers, top view
svg.desc: Front tracks red, back tracks blue, both in the same component-side coordinate system. Filled zones, solder mask and silkscreen hidden. Through-hole pads gold; via annuli grey. Exact native copper widths, pad shapes and drill sizes. Front tracks have a narrow dark separation outline at crossings with back tracks; a crossing without a plated hole is not a connection.
